name: Divider
purpose: Separate nearby content decoratively or with static separator semantics.
useWhen: Two nearby content groups need a visual or meaningful static boundary.

avoidWhen.condition: The boundary is draggable or changes a value.
avoidWhen.useInstead: an interactive splitter with value and keyboard behavior

composition: Use Divider.Root and keep decorative=true unless assistive technology must perceive the separation.

rules.statement: Choose decorative or semantic behavior from meaning, not from the desired line style.
Do not make Divider focusable or use it as a resize handle.

commonMistakes.mistake: Exposing every visual line as a separator.

validation: Confirm decorative dividers are absent from the accessibility tree.
Confirm semantic vertical dividers expose the correct orientation.
